range_semantics: node-semver 7.7.4 (Caret Ranges, Tilde Ranges, X-Ranges, Prerelease Tags) restricted as environments.md section 1.4 states: no hyphen ranges, no v inside a range, latest is *; the any comparator is spelled * in comparator_sets

resolution_cases.description: Decision 0012 section 9: joint ranges, a root weights map, an edge weight, a path overlay at the default weight, and skill and MCP members
resolution_cases.name: worked-example-default-policy

resolution_cases.description: two requirers whose ranges intersect in nothing fail context_range_conflict naming both
resolution_cases.name: range-conflict-empty-intersection

resolution_cases.description: lib is selected at 2.0.0 first; plugin then adds <2 and lib re-selects downward to the highest remaining candidate not above its previous selection
resolution_cases.name: downward-reselection

resolution_cases.description: helper lowers app to 1.0.0 and then leaves the closure when app@1.1.0's requirement on it is dropped; app keeps the lowered selection although the constraint that lowered it is gone
resolution_cases.name: selection-never-increases

resolution_cases.description: a prerelease satisfies a range only when a primitive names a prerelease on the same major.minor.patch
resolution_cases.name: prerelease-admission

resolution_cases.description: latest is * and selects the highest stable version, never a prerelease of the bound
resolution_cases.name: prerelease-excluded-by-latest

resolution_cases.description: a tag, a revision peeling to the same commit, and a range that admits its version unify on one commit
resolution_cases.name: exact-constraint-unification

resolution_cases.description: two exact constraints that peel to different commits fail context_range_conflict
resolution_cases.name: exact-constraints-disagree

resolution_cases.description: an exact constraint fixes the only candidate, and a range that does not admit its version fails context_range_conflict
resolution_cases.name: exact-outside-range

resolution_cases.description: a || disjunction selects the highest candidate satisfying any member
resolution_cases.name: or-highest-member

resolution_cases.description: an install with no requirement flag applies --range latest, which is *
resolution_cases.name: latest-is-star

resolution_cases.description: a source with no version tags satisfies no range; latest finds no candidate
resolution_cases.name: no-version-tags

resolution_cases.description: a root pinned by a tag that is not a version takes the manifest version at that commit
resolution_cases.name: non-version-tag-exact

resolution_cases.description: a manifest whose version differs from the version tag it resolved from fails context_version_mismatch
resolution_cases.name: version-mismatch

resolution_cases.description: a skill manifest's own exact dependencies enter as fixed candidates; the skill version is the highest version tag peeling to the pinned commit
resolution_cases.name: skill-exact-dependency

resolution_cases.description: two direct requirers disagree on a member's edge weight and the root's weights map does not name it: context_weight_conflict
resolution_cases.name: weight-conflict

resolution_cases.description: the same disagreement is a warning when the root's weights map names the member; the root has the final word
resolution_cases.name: weight-conflict-root-map-wins

resolution_cases.description: a non-root member carrying a non-empty weights map fails context_weights_not_root at resolution
resolution_cases.name: weights-not-root

resolution_cases.description: a package named both on a root edge with a weight and in the root's weights map fails context_weights_duplicate
resolution_cases.name: weights-duplicate

resolution_cases.description: a root weights entry naming a package outside the closure fails context_weight_unknown
resolution_cases.name: weight-unknown

resolution_cases.description: an overlay that needs a skill version the root forbids is a reported context_range_conflict, never a silent second copy
resolution_cases.name: overlay-joint-resolution-conflict

resolution_cases.description: a git overlay joins the closure with its declared weight; a member that is both an overlay and a requirement takes the overlay's weight
resolution_cases.name: overlay-git-explicit-weight

resolution_cases.description: an overlay declaration that repeats a name already declared is environment_composition_invalid
resolution_cases.name: overlay-duplicate-name
